coords: normalised 0-1, origin top-left of the frame
note: explode.frames[j].anchors are the 2D anchor points of each labelled part in explode frame j; labels are meant to be shown on the last (fully exploded) frame. rotate anchors are informational (visible=false means occluded at that angle).

parts.name: Integrated Heat Spreader (IHS)
parts.description: The nickel-plated copper lid that protects the chips and spreads their heat evenly into the cooler mounted on top.

parts.name: Thermal Interface (Solder)
parts.description: A thin soldered metal layer between the chips and the lid that carries heat out of the silicon far better than paste.

parts.name: CPU Chiplet (CCD)
parts.description: The core chiplet that holds the processor cores and their cache, built as its own small piece of silicon.

parts.name: I/O Die
parts.description: A separate die that handles memory, PCIe and other connections, linking the core chiplet to the rest of the PC.

parts.name: Substrate
parts.description: The green layered circuit board the dies sit on. It fans their tiny connections out to the pins underneath.

parts.name: PGA Pins (AM4)
parts.description: The grid of gold-plated pins on the underside that drops into the AM4 motherboard socket.

parts.name: Pin 1 Indicator
parts.description: The gold triangle in one corner that lines up with the matching mark on the socket so the chip goes in the right way.
